source.question: When was well F-11 B completed, and how does its completion report's timing compare with when it started producing?

note: Reviewed Oct 31 (f11b_completion): fair by the rules. '6 weeks' and '42 days' between two evidence dates were never calculated, and a detail's dates come from uncited results.

submission.summary: Well F-11 B was handed over to production on 2013-07-23 and started producing the next day on 2013-07-24, with about 3,923 Sm3 of oil in its first 8 producing days in July 2013; its Final Completion Report was issued on 2013-09-04.

findings.claim: Well F-11 B was completed and handed over to production on 2013-07-23 after a drilling and completion campaign starting 2013-05-28.
findings.detail: well_operations shows job 2013-05-28 to 2013-07-23 kind drilling with 57 report_days, summary on 2013-07-23: Performed final pressure testing on F-11B tree and handed well over to production. list_wells shows F-11 first_oil 2013-07-24. Sum 858.0 hrs 35.7 days total; Run Completion 101.8 hrs 4.2 days from 30 Jun 2013; Perforation 310.3 hrs 12.9 days from 09 Jul 2013.

findings.claim: The Final Well Report, Completion for 15/9-F-11 B was issued as Final on 2013-09-04.
findings.detail: search_reports and read_report_page show document f11b_completion issued 2013-09-04, title Final Well Report, Completion, 15/9-F-11 B. Quote: FINAL WELL REPORT Drilling and Completion License NO PL046BS Well NO 15/9-F-11 B Valid from 2013-09-04 Page 52 of 64. Report issued about 42 days after first oil.

findings.claim: First production occurred on 2013-07-24, one day after handover, with 3,923 Sm3 oil produced over 8 producing days in July 2013.
findings.detail: list_wells: F-11 first_oil 2013-07-24. production_monthly 2013-07: 8 producing_days, 3923 oil_sm3, choke 9.27%, water_cut 0.0.

findings.claim: Completion operations totaled 858 hours (35.7 days) from mid-June to handover.
findings.detail: read_report_page p11 table: Sum 858.0 hrs 35.7 days; Run Completion 30.Jun.2013 14:15 Actual 101.8 hrs 4.2 days; Perforation 09.Jul.2013 00:45 Actual 310.3 hrs 12.9 days. All quotes exact. Final testing 2013-07-22 to 2013-07-23.

rows: Well F-11 B primary objective is oil production from Hugin formation and completion type is 7” monobore

The F-11B IOR completion is a 7” monobore design with 7” production tubing and 7” cemented liner.
Well F-11 B completion incorporates a 7” x 9 5/8” production packer, single DHG for reservoir pressure and temperature monitoring and a TRSCSSV down hole safety valve
The completion incorporates: 7” x 9 5/8” production packer, single DHG for reservoir pressure and temperature monitoring and a TRSCSSV down hole safety valve.
Well F-11 B has a 10 ¾” surface tieback casing installed from the subsea WH to the surface WH inside the 14” Production Riser
Prior to the completion a 10 ¾” surface tieback casing is installed from the subsea WH to the surface WH inside the 14” Production Riser, connecting the subsea and surface WH.

summaries.summary: Drilled 12 1/4" hole from 2627 m MD to 2787 m MD.
Drilled and orientated 12 1/4" hole from 2787 m to 2917 m. POOH from 2917 m to 368 m to change bit.

POOH with 12 1/4" BHA. L/O mud motor, CoPilot, AutoTrack and 12 1/4" bit. P/U back-up motor, Copilot, AutoTrack and 12 1/4" bit. RIH to 2870 m reamed/washed in hole to 2917 m. Drilled and orientated 12 1/4" hole to 3104 m.
Inflow tested SCSSSV and HMV. R/D wireline equipment and prepared for skidding operations..
Performed pressure testing of valves on F-11 Xmas tree in preparation for handover to production department.
Performed final pressure testing on F-11B tree and handed well over to production.
Lifted wireline equipment off vessel and started to spot same.
Spotted wireline equipment and hooked up same. Leak and function tested BOP. Started to build lubricator sections and GIH.
Completed spotting equipment. Well handed over from production department. Rigged up wireline equipment.
Completed rigging up WL equipment. Leak tested R/U to 20/345 bar. Logged first sigma pass from 4530 m to 3440 m. Started to log first IC pass from 4254 m.
Completed first set of RST IC logging passes from 4254 to 3470 m. Started second set of RST IC logging passes in same intervals.
Completed logging RST IC passes. Performed shut in PLT pass. Started to bean up well for flowing PLT passes.
Logged three flowing PLT passes. Evaluated data and decided to perforate two new zones. POOH and L/D BHA. Started to prepare perforation gun.
M/U BHA #2 Tractor and 4,5" perforating guns. RIH and performed correlation and orientation of the perforation gun.
Perforated zone from 3960-3969 m. POOH and prepared toolstring for next perforation. RIH and started to correlate depth prior to perforate.
Perforated zone from 3910 m to 3919 m. POOH and L/D toolstring. Rigged down equipment and tested XMT barriers. Handed well over to production.
Recieved and spotted equipment
Prepared WL equipment for rig up. Started to shut-in well.
Prepared WL equipment for rig-up. Handover of well. Rigged up WL Equipment
Perforated well. R/D WL equipment
R/D WL equipment
Received well from production. Rigged up WL equipment. Unable to leak test Rig-up.
Waited for repair of grease pump. R/D WL equipment and changed O-rings in X-over. R/U WL equipment.

Tested RU. Opened well and RIH to 2830 m. Tractored down to 3735 mMD. Made multiple correlation passes. Set straddle across interval 3674.4 - 3685 mMD. POOH and L/D BHA. M/U BHA #3 (Straddle-Tractor) and RIH.
Correlated and set straddle. POOH. L/D BHA and R/D WL equipment.
Packed equipment. Cleaned workspace. Demobilized personell.
- Skidded cantilever onto slot F-11 - R/U WL equipment - Attempted to pressure test lower WL riser and WL BOP
- R/U WL pressure control equipment - Bullheaded sea water into the well - RIH w/ deep set barrier plug

- Installed deepset barrier plug. Pressure tested and inflow tested same - Cut 7in tubing above production packer - Instaled shallow set barrier plug. Pressure tested same - Started R/D WL pressure control equipment
- Finished R/D WL - N/D X-tree and spacer spool - N/U HP riser and BOP, performed connector test - R/U casing handling equipment - RIH w/ THRT
- Landed and engaged THRT - Pumped open shallow set barrier plug - Retrieved TH and 500m of tubing - RIH w/ tubing, circulated well clean to sea water
- Placed balanced cement plug in 9 5/8in casing - Pulled and L/D 600m of tubing - RIH w/ tubing on spear, tagged cement - Released spear and left tubing in the well

- POOH w/ spear - Retrieved MS-T seal assy - Cut 10 3/4in tieback casing - RIH w/ spear and pulled 10 3/4in tieback casing - Released and retrieved tieback adapter - Punched below 10 3/4in subsea casing hanger and ventilated annulus - M/U and RIH w/ cutter BHA to cut 9 5/8in casing
- Cut 9 5/8in casing - Milled 10 3/4in subsea casing hanger - Fished 10 3/4in casing fish and secured on surface - Pulled 34 joints of 10 3/4in casing, L/D same

- Finished puling 10 3/4in casing to X-over - Pulled 9 5/8in casing - Installed 14in EZSV (lower) - Cut 14in casing - Punched below 14in subsea casing hanger - Installed 14in EZSV (upper) - Displaced C-annulus to sea water
- WOC, meanwhile performed mantenance on rig equipment - Pressure tested C-annulus cement plug
- Placed balanced cement plug in 14in casing - N/D BOP
- Skidded to well F-11 B - Pulled production riser
None

result.note: Daily reports exist for drilling and for work on the well (wireline, plugs, perforations, production logs), not for days of normal production. A job's date is the day the work was done; kind is drilling, completion, workover (work on a producing or injecting well) or abandonment. Ask for one day to see every operation line.
